static_traits.name: 林贝娜
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系较以往更疏离并易烦躁；有几位朋友可求助，但尚not yet与任何人讨论此具体问题
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病史；既往without相似心理问题与治疗经历
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性Good、语速平稳，配合度高；能识do not与描述自动化思维；情绪以Anxiety、担忧为主

basic_info.main_problem: “在一次电话中，商业教练对我说话很简短，我一直在想他not想再和我合作了，这个念头让我很Anxiety和紧张。”
basic_info.core_demands: 因这一事件引发的持续性压力与Anxiety已影响到工作专注与整体身心健康，来访者希望获得指导与支持。

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not够胜任

special_situations.event: In a phone call with a business coach last week, the other's tone was brief and attitude appeared cold
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他对我态度冷淡，就说明我做错了或not够好，他可能not想再合作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复自我Reflection与复盘、担心显得“需求感强/not专业”而回避直接沟通
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他not想再和我合作了；一定是我哪里做错了

special_situations.event: At moments when needing to interact with a business coach or make decisions for the online business
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现得not确定或处理not好，他会看轻我并终止合作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拖延决策、反复预演对话以降低被negate的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up; he will end the collaboration

special_situations.event: Repeatedly recalls the details of that brief, abrupt phone call
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I say one wrong sentence on the call, it may cause the relationship to break down
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断在脑中复盘、道德自责以期“改正错误”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault，他对我not耐烦是因为I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 感受到让线上业务成功的Increased stress
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果业务not成功，就证明我not行；一旦教练not支持，我的事业会崩盘
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively attends to negative cues, frequently seeks reassurance and external cues to assess risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If this collaboration goes wrong, my career is over

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and supported by professional others (such as a coach), maintaining a stable cooperative relationship
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被negate或被视为not专业，从而失去重要关系与机会
defense_goal: 通过自责与回避直接澄清来降低Being rejected的风险
Maintains surface harmony to preserve a fragile sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易犯错的求助者/下属
object_relations.object_representation: 可能随时deny与拒绝的评判者/掌控者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate directly with the coach and clarify the other's attitude or intention
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 如果我开口表达担忧，会显得需要感强与not专业，从而被看低或Being rejected
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, emphasizes professional image and risk concerns, proposes various possible negative consequences to postpone or avoid direct communication

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the emotional impact of that brief phone call
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 直接触及Being rejected的感受会让我失控，理性分析更安全
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Inclined to analyze 'causes and possibilities', describes events in objective wording, reducing emotional vocabulary and emotional expression

manifestations: 担心教练not再合作导致关系破裂与职业上的孤立
More distant from colleagues, irritable, reduced emotional connection
Hesitates to express genuine concerns to avoid seeming 'needy'
Bearing choice and responsibility for online business success, causing intense pressure
在关键决策时段Anxiety升高、倾向拖延与反复思考

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 担心表达担忧会显得需要感强或not专业
Emphasizes controlling her image when speaking to avoid being looked down on

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 将自己的Self-doubt与not安Projection为“对方厌烦我、想结束合作”
Still infers others' negative intentions when lacking evidence

positive_force: 与教练过去合作Good、对方通常开放且支持
能识do not并描述自动化思维，愿意进行现实检验与重构
Has some social support (several friends to turn to for help)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and personalization are marked
对线上业务成败的高压力与高标准加剧Anxiety
回避直接澄清以规避Being rejected的风险，导致误解持续
Anxiety导致睡眠与食欲受损、Decreased work focus

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent excessive worry and repeated thinking around the relationship with the business coach
antecedent: Making key decisions related to the online business
target_behavior.core_reason: 对Being rejected/被negate的担忧与“I am not good enough”的信念
target_behavior.function: 通过反复思考获得暂时的控制感与安全感，回避not确定性
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified，Sleep and appetite affected，Decreased work focus

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids communicating sensitive concerns directly with the coach
antecedent: Plans to express concerns about that phone call to the coach
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被视为需要感强或not专业，从而Being rejected
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在拒绝与尴尬，暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Misunderstandings are hard to clarify in time; negative assumptions persist and expand

target_behavior.behavior: 在职场对同事表现出Withdrawal与易怒
target_behavior.core_reason: Anxiety累积与情绪not yet被表达，转而外显为防御性反应
target_behavior.function: 短暂释放紧张、Reduced socializing负荷
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal relationships受损，支持系统利用减少，进一步加重孤立感与Anxiety
